name: The Orc Report
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, you find a severed orc hand gripping a bone tube. Inside lies a dirt-stained parchment in Orcish, meant for a Theramore Lieutenant.

sections.title: A Hand in the Dirt
sections.body: In the loose dirt, you find a severed orc hand gripping a tube carved from bone. Inside is a dirt-stained parchment written in Orcish. It seems significant, and a Theramore Lieutenant is the one to show it to.

sections.title: The Lieutenant's Verdict
sections.body: The Theramore Lieutenant admits to reading Orcish poorly. Still, the lieutenant takes the parchment for an orc spy's report.

faq.q: What is hidden in the loose dirt?
aliases: what do you find in loose dirt
faq.answer: In the loose dirt, you find a severed orc hand clutching a tube carved from bone. Inside is a dirt-stained parchment.

aliases: where do I take the report
faq.answer: A Theramore Lieutenant should receive the parchment.

faq.q: What language is the parchment written in?
faq.answer: The parchment is written in Orcish, and its writing seems significant.
